about: The paraphrase table of kernel/speech.py paraphrase(text, k) (docs/design/VERIFY_HARDENING.md 13.1, must-pass family M5). groups: phrases that say the same thing; paraphrase k replaces each phrase of a group found in the text by the member k places further on in its group (k = 1, 2, ...; wrapping), longest phrases first, never inside a replaced span. numbers: k = 2 also writes small whole numbers as words and times as "half past" / "quarter to" forms (and back). A rewrite is kept only when the paraphrase still parses to the same claims as the original (speech.same_claims), so a table entry can never change what an utterance asserts; the unit change of M5 (cm and in, g and oz, C and F, l and gal) is convert_units(text, system).
